messages:
maria: Starting RC origination for `v3.0.0-rc1`. Aim: promote today in the 14:00-15:30 PT window. Needs: artifacts pinned, QA signoff, KV warm, canary plan, rollback playbook reviewed.
owen: CI artifacts built: `registry.redwood/gateway:v3.0.0-rc1` and `registry.redwood/worker:v3.0.0-rc1`. I'll pin both.
sasha: QA run in staging kicked off. Running full smoke + critical e2e. Will report failures inline.
paul: Rollback playbook updated with DB rollback steps and feature-flag flipbacks. I added quick commands for ops: `deploybot abort` and `deploybot rollback --to=registry.redwood/gateway:v2.9.5`.
deploy-bot: Heads up: use `/deploy promote --env=prod --artifact=ARTIFACT --canary=1% --stages=4 --pin=true --deadman=15m` for this promotion. Auto-rollback triggered if error rate >0.7% sustained or p95 > baseline+40% for 5m.
maria: KV warm plan: start shard-0 -> shard-2 -> shard-1 during canary pause. Sasha, can you run a quick token-cold vs token-warm check post-canary?
sasha: QA: two unrelated flaky tests failed initially, requeued; now only `auth.test::token_refresh` failing persistently. Investigating.
owen: Pin done for both artifacts and manifest immutable. Pushed tags and added release entry in CHANGELOG.md.
paul: Investigate `auth.test::token_refresh` — could be a mock expiry mismatch. QA-bot, can you run the auth smoke matrix with expanded timeouts?
qa-bot: Running auth matrix with +10s timeouts. ETA ~6m.
sasha: Timeout adjustment fixed the repro locally; likely timing-sensitive. We'll still proceed but watch auth route metrics closely during canary.
maria: All signoffs except Sasha's QA watch. If QA okay, someone from ops should post the promote command in #ops.
sasha: QA green on staging after timeouts. :white_check_mark: Ready.
owen: I'll post promote in ops in 5. Command: `/deploy promote --env=prod --artifact=registry.redwood/gateway:v3.0.0-rc1 --canary=1% --stages=4 --pin=true --deadman=15m`
deploy-bot: Promotion started. Stage 1 (1%) live. Health checks running: p95 latency threshold 200ms, error <0.7%.
paul: Monitoring auth routes. Minor uptick in 401s on one canary host, investigating.
maria: Hold on stage progression if 401s keep rising. Owen, can you snapshot traces for request id range `r-2026-gtw`?
owen: Snapshotting traces now and attaching in ops thread.
deploy-bot: Stage 1 healthy after 6m. Proceeding to stage 2 (10%).
paul: At 10% we see error rate on `/auth/refresh` at 1.2% for 3m and increasing. Latency p95 also up ~50%. Triggering manual hold.
deploy-bot: Promotion paused by ops. Current traffic 10% on `v3.0.0-rc1`.
sasha: Reproduced in staging with same config: new token cache TTL behavior causes occasional stale cache misses. I've opened a patch branch to tighten cache expiration and will run a hotfix candidate.
maria: Given risk, vote: rollback now to `v2.9.5` or patch-and-retry? Quick check from ops: cost of rollback is low, traffic will shift in ~3m.
owen: I vote rollback. Keep it simple, avoid user impact.
paul: Agree. Initiating rollback: `deploybot rollback --to=registry.redwood/gateway:v2.9.5 --grace=3m`
deploy-bot: Rollback command received. Gradual traffic shift starting. Deadman during rollback: monitor error budgets.
sasha: I'll backport cache TTL fix into `v2.9.5-hotfix` if needed, but first let's confirm rollback stability.
paul: Rollback in progress. Stage metrics show error rates dropping back to baseline across regions.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete - production on `registry.redwood/gateway:v2.9.5`. No automated rollback needed.
maria: Good job team. Closing this RC candidate for now. Action items: (1) Sasha to submit patch for cache TTL and unit tests, (2) Owen to run additional auth integration tests with varying timeouts, (3) QA to run extended auth matrix, (4) Re-originate RC after patch validated, new RC should be `v3.0.0-rc1-hotfix` or `-rc2`. I'll update release tracker and ping stakeholders.
sasha: Filing PR with tests now. Tagging owners @maria @paul.
owen: I'll unpin the worker artifact pin until we re-originate.
qa-bot: Post-rollback smoke checks ok. No lingering errors.
maria: Thanks all. We'll reconvene for a new RC attempt after the patch. :coffee:
